title: Laredo hosts binational breakfast welcoming Jalisco business delegation
excerpt: The City of Laredo joined Grupo Uni-Trade and COMCE Noreste Capítulo Laredo for a binational breakfast welcoming a business delegation from Jalisco, with Mayor Victor D. Treviño and Nuevo Laredo representatives talking trade and cross-border growth.
content:
The City of Laredo took part in a binational breakfast this morning welcoming a business delegation from the Council of Industrial Chambers of Jalisco, the city said.

The breakfast was hosted by Grupo Uni-Trade and COMCE Noreste Capítulo Laredo, and brought together Mayor Dr. Victor D. Treviño, representatives from Nuevo Laredo and industry leaders to talk about economic growth and working together across the border.

During the event, City of Laredo Communications and Marketing Director Felipe G. Romero III pointed to Port Laredo's strengths — its international bridges, transportation networks and logistics infrastructure — as reasons the region stands out as a trade hub.

The city thanked the organizers and participants for building connections that strengthen the region's role as a leading international trade hub.

Source: City of Laredo, Nov. 12, 2026.
